settings.about_body: Former operator, now executive coach. Fifteen years inside operating roles, twenty years as a coach. I work with founders, C-suite operators, and senior functional leaders, people who already know how to run hard quarters but want sharper decisions, quieter minds, and truer leadership. My approach draws from Acceptance & Commitment Therapy, Polyvagal theory, and lived operating experience.
